feature: LMS.AssessmentService (Phase 1, service #7) — quiz/exam engine with Redis-backed sessions, MCQ/TrueFalse auto-grading, and AssessmentSubmitted publish

tasks.title: Add AssessmentSubmitted + EssaySubmitted contracts
tasks.spec: Create src/LMS.Contracts/Assessment/AssessmentSubmitted.cs and EssaySubmitted.cs matching the exact shapes locked in .claude/contracts.md section 3. AssessmentSubmitted: (Guid UserId, Guid AssessmentId, Guid CourseId, Guid TenantId, float Score, bool Passed, DateTimeOffset OccurredAt). EssaySubmitted: (Guid UserId, Guid SubmissionId, Guid AssessmentId, Guid TenantId, DateTimeOffset OccurredAt). Records, no body. Verify project compiles.

tasks.title: Scaffold 4-project AssessmentService skeleton + Domain entities/DTOs/enums
tasks.spec: Create src/services/LMS.AssessmentService/{Domain,Infrastructure,Api,Migrator}/*.csproj per the standard layout in .claude/contracts.md section 1. Add all entity classes (Assessment, Question, AssessmentAttempt, AttemptAnswer, AssessmentSession), enums (QuestionType, GradingStatus), QuestionOption record, and all DTO records (CreateAssessmentRequest, CreateQuestionRequest, UpdateQuestionRequest, SubmitAnswersRequest, SubmittedAnswer, QuestionDto, AssessmentDto, SessionStartedDto, AssessmentResultDto, GradedAnswerDto, AttemptSummaryDto, AssessmentAnalyticsDto, QuestionStatDto) into LMS.AssessmentService.Domain. All TenantEntity descendants. Add solution-level references. NO endpoints / DbContext yet.

tasks.title: Infrastructure: AssessmentDbContext + EF config + Redis session store + grading service
tasks.spec: Create AssessmentDbContext (schema 'assessments') in LMS.AssessmentService.Infrastructure/Data/. Apply global TenantId query filter via reflection over TenantEntity descendants. Configure jsonb conversion for Question.Options, xmin row version on all four entities, cascade deletes (Assessment->Question, AssessmentAttempt->AttemptAnswer), all indexes per contracts section 2. Implement IAssessmentSessionStore using StackExchange.Redis with key 'assessment:session:{sid}', JSON serialisation, TTL = TimeLimitSeconds+60 or DefaultSessionTtlSeconds. Implement IGradingService (pure function: grades MCQ/TrueFalse comparing SelectedOptionIndex to CorrectOptionIndex; ShortAnswer/Essay -> IsCorrect=null, points=0, GradingStatus=PendingReview). Add ITenantContext + DI extension AddAssessmentInfrastructure. Reference LMS.Contracts.

tasks.title: Initial migration + Migrator host
tasks.spec: Generate EF migration 20260427_001_InitialAssessmentSchema in LMS.AssessmentService.Infrastructure/Migrations creating schema 'assessments', tables (assessments, questions, assessment_attempts, attempt_answers) with all indexes from contracts section 2, plus MassTransit outbox/inbox/state tables in same schema. Implement Migrator Program.cs as IHostedService that calls Database.MigrateAsync once and exits 0 (Aspire WaitForCompletion pattern, mirrors ProgressService.Migrator).

tasks.title: MassTransit wiring + CourseArchived consumer (deactivate assessments)
tasks.spec: In Infrastructure: register MassTransit with EF outbox over AssessmentDbContext, kebab-case endpoint formatter, RabbitMQ host, retry Intervals(1s,5s,30s). Implement CourseArchivedConsumer: sets Assessment.IsActive=false for all assessments where CourseId == msg.CourseId under tenant filter; idempotent on EventId via inbox. Wire in Api Program.cs. Reference LMS.Contracts AssessmentSubmitted (publish, used by Api in T6) and CourseArchived (consume).

tasks.title: Api: Minimal API endpoints + validators + Program.cs
tasks.spec: Implement all endpoints listed in contracts section 6 under LMS.AssessmentService.Api/Endpoints/ (CRUD assessments, CRUD questions, start session, submit, my-attempts, analytics). Use HttpContext.GetUserId/GetTenantId/GetRoles/IsInRole helpers. Apply role checks (instructor/admin for create+analytics; student for sessions/submit). Strip CorrectOptionIndex+Explanation for student GET. Implement submit flow per contracts section 6 'Submit semantics' (load Redis, grade, persist attempt+answers in single tx, outbox-publish AssessmentSubmitted, delete Redis session). FluentValidation validators including INVALID_QUESTION_INDEX rule. Program.cs: AddServiceDefaults, AddNpgsqlDbContext('lms-assessment'), AddRedisClient('redis'), AddAssessmentInfrastructure, TenantMiddleware, MapDefaultEndpoints, RFC7807 ProblemDetails error mapping, port 5107 in launchSettings.json.

tasks.title: AppHost wiring (assessment-migrator + assessment Api with redis)
tasks.spec: Edit src/LMS.AppHost/Program.cs to add assessmentDb resource, assessment-migrator (WaitFor assessmentDb), assessment Api (WithReference assessmentDb, rabbitmq, redis; WaitForCompletion(assessmentMigrator)), and gateway.WithReference(assessment). Aspire resource name MUST be 'assessment'. Gateway YARP route already exists in appsettings.json — DO NOT modify. Add LMS.AppHost.csproj <ProjectReference> to the new Api + Migrator csproj.

tasks.title: Integration + architecture + contract tests
tasks.spec: Add tests/LMS.IntegrationTests/AssessmentService/ with Testcontainers Postgres + Redis + RabbitMQ + MassTransit harness covering every bullet in contracts section 9 'Integration'. Extend LMS.ArchitectureTests with TenantEntity inheritance + global filter checks for all four entities and 'Api project must NOT reference JwtBearer'. Extend LMS.ContractTests with the two event-shape tests.

tasks.title: Tenant-isolation + correct-answer-leak audit
tasks.spec: Audit AssessmentService end-to-end for: (a) every query goes through DbContext (global filter applied), (b) student-facing GETs strip CorrectOptionIndex+Explanation, (c) submit verifies Session.UserId==X-User-Id and Session.TenantId==X-Tenant-Id (leak-safe 404 on mismatch), (d) Redis keys never cross tenants (sid is server-generated GUID — confirm), (e) no JWT validation in Api project, (f) Aspire resource name = 'assessment'. Produce findings; fix any HIGH/CRITICAL.

tasks.title: End-to-end review against contracts.md + absolute rules
tasks.spec: Review T1–T9 output against .claude/contracts.md (every section) and CLAUDE.md absolute rules (TenantEntity, global filter, no direct HTTP, no JWT in services, events in LMS.Contracts only, Assessment.LessonId nullable). Run full solution build + all tests. Produce structured report; block merge on contract violations.

Update: port 5106 -> 5107; note GdprErasureRequested deferred Phase 1; add CourseArchived to consumed events; document ShortAnswer pending-review behaviour; document Assessment:DefaultSessionTtlSeconds config; mark grading queue/appeal endpoints Phase 2.
